# @kp/shared

Shared KP frontend layer (Icon, Footer, BookCover, api, money, tokens) used by KP Books and KP Wear.

## Consuming
Add to your app: `"@kp/shared": "file:../packages/kp-shared"` (or publish to npm).
Import: `import { Icon, Footer, money } from '@kp/shared';`
Import tokens: `import '@kp/shared/styles/tokens.css';`
